# yt-titles

Generate high-performing YouTube title ideas based on the user's video content description, cross-referenced with your recent top-performing videos. Use this skill whenever the user wants YouTube title suggestions, asks "what should I title this video", "give me title ideas", "title options for my video about...", "help me name this video", brainstorming video titles, or any request involving YouTube title generation or optimization. Also trigger when the user mentions titling, naming, or headlining a YouTube video even casually.

## Use

Ask your agent to use `$yt-titles`, or have it read [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) before starting the task.
